name: Chao Farm
description: Green Hill Zone, 100 of its 183 rings turned into Chao eggs (placeable type 0 -> 32) and all five of its chests refilled with the five code-driven Chao whose effect is a COUNT rather than a percentage. Hatch eggs until one of them turns up, or just open the chests. chao_level 3 is still on, so every Chao hatches at Level 1 holding its Max-tier item: Ovus revives once at Level 1 and three times at Max, Choo regenerates +1/+2/+3 PP a round, Stebsly 5/8/10% HP. Count it and we know whether ARM9 reads the item id chao_level rewrites or the stored level it cannot touch. A ring and a Chao egg differ in exactly one field, so the converted rings carry the authored egg shape in every other.
